Def.ResearchDesc: The RA-P4 Pulsed Power Hypercapacitor stores an extremely large amount of energy in its compressed bank of ultracapacitors, which can be discharged in a single pulse by compatible Rimatomics energy weapons.
Def.ResearchDescDisc: All of the required technologies for constructing hypercapacitors have been researched. PPHCs are now available for construction.

Def.label: Research energy storage
Def.description: A skilled researcher needs to study how energy can be stored more efficiently.

Def.label: Experiment with energy storage mediums
Def.description: Researchers must perform practical experiments using the weapons research bench. Rimatomics hypercapacitors are not safe unless extensive testing is performed, experimentation steps can be dangerous.
